method.entry: signal next trading day or later; open <= limit fills at open, else daily low <= limit fills at limit
method.stop: close confirmation, gap below active stop uses open; entry-day close stop included
method.gap_under_initial_stop: main case conditional cancel; separate standing-order gap-fill sensitivity
method.KEEP_LEVELS: same original signal*0.92 stop, signal*1.24 target, original signal breakeven and trend pace references
method.capital: same fixed notional per signal; missing entry=0%; no leverage sizing increase; each capture independent
method.GTC: wait through evaluation date; no arbitrary signal expiry
method.benchmark: each signal buys its market index at signal close and holds to evaluation date; NOT the prior exit-date-matched benchmark
